commit.message:
fix(platform): bind host snapshots and source build context

Bind the recorded EventStore host snapshot and preserve source context through restore.

Gate fixture publication on qualified current source and immutable package inputs.

+name: Publish Platform test extension
+
+# The fixture has its own narrow NuGet publication path. Normal tuple, catalog
+# and source-release gates for the exact current main remain prerequisites.
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      version:
+        description: Existing stable Platform source release at the exact current main
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+concurrency:
+  group: platform-test-extension-publication
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  actions: read
+
+jobs:
+  qualify:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    outputs:
+      archive_sha256: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.archive_sha256 }}
+    env:
+      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+      FIXTURE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Bind job-local proof output
+        shell: bash
+        run: printf 'FIXTURE_PROOF_OUTPUT=%s/fixture-proof.json\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          submodules: false
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
+        with:
+          node-version: '24'
+      - name: Verify publisher refusal and archive controls
+        run: |
+          node --test eng/test-extension-release/gate.test.mjs
+          python3 -B eng/test-extension-release/run-controls.py
+      - name: Require exact current source release and normal qualifications
+        run: node eng/test-extension-release/gate.mjs
+      - name: Initialize direct dependencies
+        run: git -c submodule.recurse=false submodule update --init
+      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68
+        with:
+          global-json-file: global.json
+      - name: Require the measured package SDK feature
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          constants="$(dotnet msbuild tests/fixtures/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension.csproj -p:Configuration=Release -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=false -getProperty:DefineConstants -nologo)"
+          if [[ ";$constants;" != *';HEXALITH_PLATFORM_EXTENSION_SDK;'* ]]; then
+            echo 'fixture-publication: the measured package SDK extension feature is unavailable.' >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+      - name: Compile the source-bound native fixture test
+        run: dotnet build tests/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension.Qualification.Tests/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension.Qualification.Tests.csproj -c Release -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=false -warnaserror -nodeReuse:false --disable-build-servers
+      - name: Pack only the Platform-owned fixture from package dependencies
+        id: pack
+        env:
+          PACKAGE_DIRECTORY: ${{ runner.temp }}/fixture-package
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY"
+          dotnet pack tests/fixtures/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension.csproj -c Release -p:UseHexalithProjectReferences=false -p:IsPackable=true -p:GeneratePackageOnBuild=false -p:PackageVersion="$FIXTURE_VERSION" -p:SourceRevisionId="$GITHUB_SHA" -p:RepositoryCommit="$GITHUB_SHA" -p:RepositoryUrl=https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Platform -p:RepositoryType=git -o "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY" -warnaserror -nodeReuse:false --disable-build-servers
+          python3 eng/test-extension-release/verify-package.py "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension.$FIXTURE_VERSION.nupkg" "$FIXTURE_VERSION" "$GITHUB_SHA" tests/fixtures/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension/bin/Release/net10.0/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension.dll --assets tests/fixtures/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension/obj/project.assets.json
+          cp "$FIXTURE_PROOF_OUTPUT" "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY/fixture-proof.json"
+          printf 'archive_sha256=%s\n' "$(sha256sum "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension.$FIXTURE_VERSION.nupkg" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
+        with:
+          name: platform-test-extension-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/fixture-package/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30
+
+  publish:
+    needs: qualify
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    environment: production
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      actions: read
+      id-token: write
+    env:
+      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+      FIXTURE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
+      FIXTURE_ARCHIVE_SHA256: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.archive_sha256 }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Bind downloaded qualification proof
+        shell: bash
+        run: printf 'FIXTURE_EXPECTED_PROOF=%s/fixture-package/fixture-proof.json\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          submodules: false
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
+        with:
+          node-version: '24'
+      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@a98b56852c35b8e3190ac28c8c2271da59106c68
+        with:
+          global-json-file: global.json
+      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
+        with:
+          name: platform-test-extension-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/fixture-package
+      - name: Recheck the exact qualified source before OIDC
+        run: node eng/test-extension-release/gate.mjs
+      - name: Require configured owner Trusted Publishing
+        env:
+          PUBLISH_ENABLED: ${{ vars.HEXALITH_TEST_EXTENSION_PUBLISH_ENABLED }}
+          NUGET_USER: ${{ vars.NUGET_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_USER }}
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [[ "$PUBLISH_ENABLED" != 'true' || -z "${NUGET_USER//[[:space:]]/}" ]]; then
+            echo 'fixture-publication: Platform owner Trusted Publishing is not configured and enabled.' >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+      - name: Exchange this repository's OIDC for a temporary NuGet key
+        id: nuget-login
+        uses: NuGet/login@8d196754b4036150537f80ac539e15c2f1028841
+        with:
+          user: ${{ vars.NUGET_TRUSTED_PUBLISHING_USER }}
+      - name: Publish the exact qualified fixture archive
+        env:
+          NUGET_API_KEY: ${{ steps.nuget-login.outputs.NUGET_API_KEY }}
+          PACKAGE_DIRECTORY: ${{ runner.temp }}/fixture-package
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          node eng/test-extension-release/gate.mjs
+          [[ "$FIXTURE_ARCHIVE_SHA256" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
+          test "$(sha256sum "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension.$FIXTURE_VERSION.nupkg" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "$FIXTURE_ARCHIVE_SHA256"
+          python3 eng/test-extension-release/verify-package.py "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension.$FIXTURE_VERSION.nupkg" "$FIXTURE_VERSION" "$GITHUB_SHA" --receipt "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY/package-identity.json"
+          dotnet nuget push "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY/Hexalith.Platform.TestExtension.$FIXTURE_VERSION.nupkg" --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --api-key "$NUGET_API_KEY"
+      - name: Verify the signed public archive
+        env:
+          PACKAGE_DIRECTORY: ${{ runner.temp }}/fixture-package
+        run: python3 eng/test-extension-release/verify-published.py "$PACKAGE_DIRECTORY" "$FIXTURE_VERSION" "$GITHUB_SHA"
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: platform-test-extension-publication-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/fixture-package/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare selected fresh cases with both retained broad inventories; do not infer a broad rerun."""
+import collections
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+retained = here.parent / "broad-verification-20261109"
+
+
+def normalize(name):
+    # xUnit XML and the old JSON runner encode the same quote with different escaping.
+    return name.replace("\\", "")
+
+
+def xml_cases(path):
+    return [{"name": case.attrib["name"], "result": case.attrib["result"]}
+            for case in ET.parse(path).iter("test")]
+
+
+def compare(cases, old):
+    index = collections.defaultdict(list)
+    for case in old:
+        index[normalize(case["name"])].append(case["result"])
+    rows = []
+    for case in cases:
+        previous = index[normalize(case["name"])]
+        assert len(previous) <= 1, "Ambiguous retained display name: " + case["name"]
+        rows.append({"name": case["name"], "fresh": case["result"],
+                     "retained": previous[0] if previous else None})
+    return {"freshCounts": dict(collections.Counter(case["result"] for case in cases)),
+            "common": sum(row["retained"] is not None for row in rows),
+            "added": [row["name"] for row in rows if row["retained"] is None],
+            "regressions": [row for row in rows if row["fresh"] == "Fail" and row["retained"] not in (None, "Fail")],
+            "freshFailures": [row for row in rows if row["fresh"] == "Fail"], "cases": rows}
+
+
+result = {"scope": "Focused fresh source and unchanged-pin Release/package selections versus retained Debug broad inventories; no fresh full-suite pass or broad failure total is inferred.",
+          "baselineRevision": "f7c68398cdcb494d535e789e3d9577af9e8d5d36",
+          "priorCurrentRevision": "59fb32933d76a7e71d9479e1903087a73ea66f2b", "comparisons": {}}
+for lane, filename in [("source", "parent-source-tests.xml"),
+                       ("package", "story32-preparation-published-package-classes.xml")]:
+    cases = xml_cases(here / "logs" / filename)
+    result["comparisons"][lane] = {}
+    for side in ["baseline", "current"]:
+        old = json.loads((retained / (side + "-results.json")).read_text())
+        result["comparisons"][lane][side] = compare(cases, old)
+result["story28"] = {"retainedAttribution": json.loads((retained / "regression-attribution.json").read_text()),
+                     "freshObservation": "Modified preparation tree refuses earlier at the trusted parent-plan/key and unchanged-source/test guard. Keep this distinct from the retained genuine Memories Contracts prerequisite; neither is an extension failure.",
+                     "checksWeakened": False}
+(here / "retained-comparison.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
+print(json.dumps({lane: {side: {key: len(value) if isinstance(value, list) else value for key, value in data.items() if key != "cases"}
+                        for side, data in sides.items()} for lane, sides in result["comparisons"].items()}, indent=2))

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Inspect public archives without changing repository dependency selections."""
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import urllib.request
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+import zipfile
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="story32-published-inspection-"))
+receipt = {"observedUtc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+           "work": str(work), "packages": [], "releases": {}, "qualificationCredit": False}
+
+
+def fetch(url):
+    return urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60).read()
+
+
+def inspect(path, typename):
+    command = ["dnx", "dotnet-inspect", "-y", "--", "type", typename,
+               "--library", str(path), "--json"]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
+    raw = path.parent / (path.stem + ".api.json")
+    raw.write_text(result.stdout)
+    methods = []
+    if result.returncode == 0:
+        data = json.loads(result.stdout)
+        methods = [member["signature"] for member in data.get("members", [])
+                   if member.get("name") == "CatalogPackageVersion"]
+    return {"command": command, "exitCode": result.returncode,
+            "typeFound": result.returncode == 0, "catalogPackageVersionSignatures": methods,
+            "rawOutputPath": str(raw), "rawOutputSha256": hashlib.sha256(result.stdout.encode()).hexdigest(),
+            "stderr": result.stderr}
+
+
+for repo in ["Hexalith.EventStore", "Hexalith.Builds"]:
+    url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/Hexalith/{repo}/releases?per_page=10"
+    releases = json.loads(fetch(url))
+    receipt["releases"][repo] = {"url": url, "items": [
+        {key: release[key] for key in ["tag_name", "published_at", "html_url", "target_commitish"]}
+        for release in releases]}
+
+for package, versions in [("Hexalith.EventStore.DomainService", ["4.1.0"]),
+                          ("Hexalith.EventStore.Server", ["4.1.0"]),
+                          ("Hexalith.Builds.Module.Cli", ["4.44.13", "4.45.0", "4.45.1"])]:
+    index_url = f"https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/{package.lower()}/index.json"
+    index = json.loads(fetch(index_url))
+    if package.startswith("Hexalith.EventStore") and index["versions"][-1] != "4.1.0":
+        raise RuntimeError("Published EventStore inventory changed; inspect the newer archives before drawing an availability conclusion")
+    for version in versions:
+        url = f"https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/{package.lower()}/{version}/{package.lower()}.{version}.nupkg"
+        archive = work / f"{package}.{version}.nupkg"
+        archive.write_bytes(fetch(url))
+        item = {"id": package, "version": version, "url": url, "indexUrl": index_url,
+                "latestListed": index["versions"][-1], "archiveSha256": hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
+            destination = work / f"{package}.{version}"
+            z.extractall(destination)
+            ns = ET.fromstring(z.read(next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith(".nuspec"))))
+            item["repository"] = next((e.attrib for e in ns.iter() if e.tag.endswith("repository")), None)
+            item["repositorySignaturePresent"] = ".signature.p7s" in z.namelist()
+            if package.startswith("Hexalith.Builds"):
+                dll = destination / "tools/net10.0/any/Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.dll"
+                data = dll.read_bytes()
+                item["toolingSha256"] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+                item["eventStoreExtensionsSchemaLiteral"] = b'"eventStoreExtensions"' in data
+                item["api"] = inspect(dll, "Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Runtime.CompositionDeclarationOptions")
+            else:
+                dll = destination / f"lib/net10.0/{package}.dll"
+                names = ["EventStoreExtensionApi", "EventStoreExtensionAttribute"] if package.endswith("DomainService") else ["EventStoreExtensionServiceCollectionExtensions", "EventStoreExtensionDeclaration"]
+                item["binaryMetadataNames"] = {name: name.encode() in dll.read_bytes() for name in names}
+                item["api"] = inspect(dll, ("Hexalith.EventStore.DomainService.EventStoreExtensionApi" if package.endswith("DomainService")
+                                            else "Hexalith.EventStore.Server.Extensions.EventStoreExtensionServiceCollectionExtensions"))
+        if package.startswith("Hexalith.Builds"):
+            expected = version != "4.44.13"
+            assert bool(item["api"]["catalogPackageVersionSignatures"]) == expected
+            assert item["eventStoreExtensionsSchemaLiteral"] == expected
+        else:
+            assert "not found" in item["api"]["stderr"]
+            assert not any(item["binaryMetadataNames"].values())
+        receipt["packages"].append(item)
+        print(package, version, item["archiveSha256"], flush=True)
+
+receipt["conclusion"] = {
+    "EventStore": "No published release carries the required extension API. Latest 4.1.0 lacks the types in actual DomainService and Server archives; its source predates the accepted extension work.",
+    "Builds": "4.45.0 and 4.45.1 carry the original extension manifest/catalog lookup API; 4.44.13 does not. None carries the proposed consumer-view overload. Selected 4.45.0 need not change for the original API, but the owner correction needs release/adoption.",
+    "candidateScope": "Local candidate archives demonstrate packaging mechanics only. Published package startup and automatic CI qualification remain unavailable pending approved owner release/adoption."}
+(HERE / "published-inspection.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
+print("Receipt:", HERE / "published-inspection.json")
